title: Missing Element in Sorted Array
description: Find the kth missing element in a sorted array where elements are strictly increasing.
pseudocode:
1: let missing = (nums[mid] - nums[0]) - mid
2: if missing < k: low = mid + 1
3: else: high = mid
4: return nums[low - 1] + k - ((nums[low - 1] - nums[0]) - (low - 1))

steps.note: Calculate missing elements before index mid=1 (value 7). missing = (7-4)-1 = 2.
2 < 5 is true, move low to mid + 1 (index 2).
Calculate missing elements before index mid=2 (value 9). missing = (9-4)-2 = 3.
3 < 5 is true, move low to mid + 1 (index 3).
Binary search ends. Calculate kth missing element using low=3.
